Swiss Army Bench 0.0.29

- **Find connections on this computer** (Connections page): the app reads the connections your other tools already
  know (ODBC data sources, SSMS, DBeaver, Azure Data Studio and VS Code, DataGrip and the JetBrains tools, pgAdmin,
  MySQL Workbench, HeidiSQL, Office data connection files) and looks through the app settings folders for anything
  connection-shaped. One list (the same connection from several tools as one row, ones you have marked Already
  added): tick what you want and Import. Passwords are never read: each imported connection asks for its password
  once, as a variable. It runs only when you click it.
- **Source Control:** a commit message being typed no longer vanishes when the page refreshes itself (the commit
  was quietly refused).
